notes:
Lead origin: inbound signup (developer trial) via product landing page. Small fintech focused on micro-savings and merchant rounding. Wants to add an in-app assistant for refunds + transaction explanations and an audit-friendly summarization for compliance.

First impressions: team engineering-first, prefers self-serve but wants quick answers on security. Mentioned 'we can't be slow on approvals — need SOC2 checklist before we can go live with customers'. Curious about VPC later but wants to start hosted. Cost is a constraint — token counts may be high for transaction history summarization; asked about batching & caching recommendations.

Quotes from calls:
- "We need predictable costs. If token spend spikes, that's a blocker for pilots."
- "SSO is non-negotiable for our staff access; customer data residency might come up with a bank partner."

Model preferences: leaning open-models (7B/13B) to keep costs down; open to Redwood-verified quantized variants. Wants streaming responses for chat UI. Asked about function calling for structured refund actions.

Security asks (early): SOC2 compliance evidence, SSO/SAML demo, KMS compatibility (customer-managed KMS later), audit logging retention windows. Data residency note: primarily US but may require EU region for a pilot.

POC plan proposed on call 2026-03-09: 2-week pilot using hosted API, sample prompts + evaluation set (10k transactions), measure lat/95th percentile, token usage baseline, and an ops checklist for SOC2 items. If metrics are OK, explore Dedicated or VPC options for bank partnerships.

Internal AE notes: good technical buyer (CTO + eng lead), procurement lead not yet engaged. Se assigned to run POC and help with prompt set. Keep communications concise and technical.

Action items summary:
- Send quickstart + API key guidance (Priya) — DONE 2026-02-26.
- Attach SOC2 one-pager + security FAQ (Marco) — TODO 2026-03-11.
- Schedule 30m security sync with security engineer (requested dates 2026-03-15 or 2026-03-17).
- Provide estimated token cost scenarios for 10k/50k/100k monthly transactions (engineering to calc).

Stability notes: acceptable latency target for chat = <300ms p50, p95 <800ms for short prompts; throughput moderate (50–200 rps during peak pilot). Highly cost sensitive — wants recommendations on batching, prefix caching, and smaller model fallbacks.

Potential risks: may engage competitor's free tier for initial experiments (OpenAI) if Redwood doesn't provide clear cost comps. SOC2 evidence lead time could delay pilot start by 2–3 weeks.

Suggested pitch focus: developer experience, transparent token/latency dashboards, quick SOC2 collateral, and a path to Dedicated/VPC once volume and compliance needs justify it.
